en.s: On October 13, AD 54, the Roman emperor Claudius died in Rome. His adopted son Nero succeeded him as emperor.
en.n: Ancient accounts describe poisoning, but the cause of death is not stated as certain here.

zh.s: 公元54年10月13日，罗马皇帝克劳狄在罗马去世，养子尼禄继承皇位。
zh.n: 古代史料有中毒身亡的记载，这里不将死因写成定论。

en.s: The Battle of Steppes was fought in Belgium on October 13, 1213 between Hugh Pierrepont, Bishop of Liège, and Henry I, Duke of Brabant.

zh.s: 斯特普斯战役于1213年10月13日在比利时爆发，交战双方是列日主教休·皮埃尔蓬和布拉班特公爵亨利一世。

en.t: Knights Templar are arrested across France
en.s: On October 13, 1307, agents of King Philip IV arrested Knights Templar across the kingdom of France.
en.n: The arrests were separate from the later dissolution of the order.

zh.t: 圣殿骑士在法国遭大规模逮捕
zh.s: 1307年10月13日，法国国王腓力四世的官员在全国各地逮捕圣殿骑士团成员。
zh.n: 逮捕与骑士团后来被解散是不同的事件。

en.t: Henry IV is crowned at Westminster Abbey
en.s: On October 13, 1399, Henry IV was crowned King of England at Westminster Abbey.
en.n: The coronation was separate from his accession to the throne on September 30.

zh.t: 亨利四世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕
zh.s: 1399年10月13日，亨利四世在威斯敏斯特教堂加冕为英格兰国王。
zh.n: 加冕与他在9月30日即位是不同的事件。

en.s: The Battle of Breadfield (Hungarian: Kenyérmezei csata, Romanian: Bătălia de la Câmpul Pâinii, Turkish: Ekmek Otlak Savaşı) was the most tremendous conflict fought in Transylvania up to that time in the Hungarian-Turkish Wars taking place on October 13, 1479, on the Breadfield Zsibód (Şibot) near the Mureş River. The Hungarian army was led by Pál Kinizsi, István Báthory, Vuk Branković, and Basarab Laiotă cel Bătrân. The result of the battle was an important victory for the Kingdom of Hungary and the Serbian Despotate.

zh.s: 面包田战役（匈牙利语：Kenyérmezei csata，罗马尼亚语：Bătălia de la Câmpul Pâinii，土耳其语：Ekmek Otlak Savaşı）是匈牙利—土耳其战争期间在特兰西瓦尼亚发生的一场重要冲突。1479年10月13日，匈牙利军队与奥斯曼军队在穆列什河附近的面包田齐博德（Şibot）交战。匈牙利军队由帕尔·基尼日、伊什特万·巴托里、武克·布兰科维奇和巴萨拉布·莱奥特·切尔·巴特兰率领。战斗以匈牙利王国和塞尔维亚专制公国获胜告终。

en.s: The War of the Jülich Succession, also known as the Jülich War or the Jülich-Cleves Succession Crises (German: Jülich-Klevischer Erbfolgestreit), was a war of succession in the United Duchies of Jülich-Cleves-Berg. The first phase of the war lasted between 10 June 1609 and 24 October 1610, with the second phase starting in May 1614 and finally ending on 13 October 1614.

zh.s: 于利希继承战争又称于利希战争或于利希—克莱沃斯继承危机，是发生在于利希—克莱沃—贝格联合公国的一场继承战争。第一阶段从1609年6月10日持续至1610年10月24日；第二阶段于1614年5月开始，最终于1614年10月13日结束。

en.s: The battle of Fehmarn took place north-west of the island of Fehmarn, now part of Germany, in the Baltic Sea. A combined Swedish fleet, with a large element of hired Dutch ships, defeated a Danish fleet and took 1,000 prisoners, including Ulfeldt, Benjamin Grabov and von Jasmund. The Danish admiral Pros Mund was killed in the battle.

zh.s: 费马恩海战发生在波罗的海、费马恩岛西北方向。瑞典与大量受雇的荷兰船只组成联合舰队，击败丹麦舰队并俘虏1,000人，其中包括乌尔费尔特、本杰明·格拉博和冯·亚斯蒙德。丹麦海军上将普罗斯·蒙德在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The siege of Kraków was one of the battles during the Swedish invasion of Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth (Second Northern War / Deluge). Lasting for two and a half weeks, it started on September 25 and ended on October 13, 1655. The capitulation treaty was signed on October 17, and Polish troops marched out of the city two days later.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 克拉科夫围城战是瑞典入侵波兰立陶宛联邦期间的一场战斗，属于第二次北方战争（又称“大洪水”时期）。围城持续两个半星期，从1655年9月25日开始，于10月13日结束。投降条约于10月17日签署，波兰军队两天后撤出城市。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列事件结束日期。

en.s: The Recapture of Fort Zeelandia or the Seizure of Fort Zeelandia was a minor military action on the 13 October 1667 at the end of the Second Anglo-Dutch War in which an English force under command of Rear Admiral Sir John Harman assaulted and took by force the Dutch settlement and fortress of Zeelandia (present day Paramaribo) under Maurits de Rame.

zh.t: 英军重新夺回泽兰迪亚堡
zh.s: 1667年10月13日，第二次英荷战争末期，约翰·哈曼爵士海军少将率领的英军攻占了由毛里茨·德·拉姆指挥的荷兰泽兰迪亚定居点和要塞。该地现为苏里南帕拉马里博。这是一场小规模军事行动。

en.s: The Battle of Gegodog (also spelled Battle of Gogodog) took place on 13 October 1676 during the Trunajaya rebellion, and resulted in the victory of the rebel forces over the Mataram army led by the Crown Prince Pangeran Adipati Anom. Gegodog is located on the northeastern coast of Java, east of Tuban. Prior to the battle, Trunajaya invaded eastern Java and occupied Surabaya and other towns.

zh.s: 格戈多格战役（亦作戈戈多格战役）于1676年10月13日特鲁纳贾亚叛乱期间爆发。叛军击败了由王储帕内兰·阿迪帕蒂·阿诺姆率领的马打兰军队。格戈多格位于爪哇岛东北海岸、图班以东。战斗前，特鲁纳贾亚入侵爪哇东部，占领泗水等城镇。

en.s: The siege of Port Royal (5–13 October 1710), also known as the Conquest of Acadia, was a military siege conducted by British regular and provincial forces under the command of Francis Nicholson against a French Acadian garrison and the Wabanaki Confederacy under the command of Daniel d'Auger de Subercase, at the Acadian capital, Port Royal.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 皇家港围城战又称阿卡迪亚征服，是一场军事围城战，发生于1710年10月5日至13日。弗朗西斯·尼科尔森率领英国正规军和地方部队，进攻驻守阿卡迪亚首府皇家港的法国阿卡迪亚守军和瓦巴纳基联盟。法军由丹尼尔·多热·德·苏贝尔卡斯指挥。
zh.n: 本条记录的是资料框所列事件结束日期。

en.t: Charles Messier discovers the Whirlpool Galaxy
en.s: On October 13, 1773, Charles Messier discovered the object now known as the Whirlpool Galaxy, or M51. Its companion galaxy was discovered separately by Pierre Méchain in 1781.
en.n: The 1773 discovery refers to M51a; the companion M51b was discovered later.

zh.s: 1773年10月13日，夏尔·梅西耶发现了后来被称为涡状星系的天体，编号M51。它的伴星系由皮埃尔·梅尚于1781年另行发现。
zh.n: 1773年的发现指M51a，伴星系M51b是在后来发现的。

en.t: The Continental Congress establishes the Continental Navy (predecessor of the United States Navy)
en.s: The Continental Navy was the navy of the United Colonies and United States from 1775 to 1785. It was founded on October 13, 1775 by the Continental Congress to fight against British forces and their allies as part of the American Revolutionary War. In 1776, Commodore Esek Hopkins was appointed by Congress to command the navy.

zh.t: 大陆会议设立大陆海军
zh.s: 大陆海军是1775年至1785年间美洲殖民地联合体和美国的海军。大陆会议于1775年10月13日设立这支海军，在美国独立战争期间对抗英国军队及其盟友。1776年，国会任命埃塞克·霍普金斯准将指挥大陆海军。

en.t: The White House cornerstone is laid
en.s: On October 13, 1792, the cornerstone of the future White House was laid in Washington, D.C., marking the start of construction.
en.n: This was the start of construction, rather than the opening of the completed residence.

zh.s: 1792年10月13日，白宫在华盛顿特区举行奠基仪式，建设工程由此开始。
zh.n: 这里记录的是开工奠基，并非住宅建成启用。

en.s: In the First Battle of Wissembourg (13 October 1793) an Allied army commanded by Dagobert Sigmund von Wurmser attacked the French Army of the Rhine under Jean Pascal Carlenc. After an ineffectual resistance, the French army abandoned its fortified line behind the Lauter River and retreated toward Strasbourg in confusion. This engagement of the War of the First Coalition occurred on the eastern border of France about 60 kilometres (37 mi) north of Strasbourg. After the siege of Mainz in which the Prussian army captured the city, the Army of the Rhine fell back into the Lines of Weissenburg, a position first fortified in 1706.

zh.s: 第一次魏森堡战役于1793年10月13日爆发，由达戈贝特·西格蒙德·冯·武姆泽尔率领的盟军进攻让·帕斯卡尔·卡伦指挥的法国莱茵军团。法国军队抵抗无效，放弃劳特河后方的防线，混乱地撤往斯特拉斯堡。这场第一次反法同盟战争中的战斗发生在法国东部边境，距斯特拉斯堡以北约60公里（37英里）。普鲁士军队攻占美因茨后，莱茵军团退至魏森堡防线；该防线最初修建于1706年。

en.s: The action of 13 October 1796 was a minor naval engagement of the War of the First Coalition, fought off the Mediterranean coast of Spain near Cartagena between the Royal Navy 32-gun frigate HMS Terpsichore under Captain Richard Bowen and the Spanish Navy 34-gun frigate Mahonesa under Frigate Captain Tomás de Ayalde. The action was the first battle of the Anglo-Spanish War, coming just eight days after the Spanish declaration of war.

zh.s: 1796年10月13日海战是第一次反法同盟战争期间的一场小规模海战，在西班牙地中海沿岸、卡塔赫纳附近爆发。交战双方是理查德·鲍恩上校指挥的英国皇家海军32炮护卫舰“特尔普西科瑞号”和托马斯·德·阿亚尔德护卫舰上校指挥的西班牙皇家海军34炮护卫舰“马奥内萨号”。这是英西战争的首场战斗，距西班牙宣战仅八天。

en.s: The 1807 Ohio gubernatorial election was held on October 13, 1807, in order to elect the Governor of Ohio. Democratic-Republican candidate and former Chief Justice of the Ohio Supreme Court Return J. Meigs Jr. initially won the election against fellow Democratic-Republican candidates Nathaniel Massie and Thomas Worthington. However, it was determined by the Ohio State Legislature that Meigs did not meet the residency requirements in order to take office as Governor of Ohio.

en.s: The Battle of Queenston Heights was the first major battle in the War of 1812 and resulted in a British victory. It took place on 13 October 1812, near Queenston, Upper Canada (the present-day province of Ontario). It was fought between United States regulars and New York militia forces led by Major General Stephen Van Rensselaer, and British regulars, York and Lincoln militia and Mohawk warriors led by Major General Isaac Brock, and Major General Roger Hale Sheaffe, who took command when Brock was killed.

zh.s: 昆士顿高地战役是1812年战争中的第一场大型战役，结果是英军获胜。战斗于1812年10月13日在上加拿大的昆士顿附近进行，该地现属安大略省。交战双方分别是美国正规军和纽约州民兵，由斯蒂芬·范·伦斯勒少将率领；以及英军正规部队、约克和林肯民兵与莫霍克战士，由艾萨克·布洛克少将和罗杰·黑尔·谢菲少将率领。布洛克阵亡后，谢菲接掌指挥。

en.s: The Battle of Lenino was a tactical World War II engagement that took place on 12 and 13 October 1943, north of the village of Lenino in the Mogilev region of Byelorussia. zh.s: 列尼诺战役是第二次世界大战中的一场战术性战斗，于1943年10月12日至13日在白俄罗斯莫吉廖夫地区列尼诺村以北爆发。该战斗属于苏军斯帕斯-杰缅斯克进攻行动的一部分，行动目标是清除第聂伯河东岸的德军，并突破“豹—沃坦”防线。

en.s: The Battle of John's Knoll–Trevor's Ridge was fought from 12–13 October 1943 during World War II. The battle was part of the Markham and Ramu Valley – Finisterre Range campaign, which consisted of series of actions fought by Australian and Japanese troops in the Territory of New Guinea as the Australian 7th Division advanced through the foothills of the Finisterre Range from Dumpu towards Bogadjim, near Madang on the northern coast, following the capture of Lae in mid-September 1943.

zh.t: 约翰斯山—特雷弗斯山脊战役
zh.s: 约翰斯山—特雷弗斯山脊战役于1943年10月12日至13日第二次世界大战期间爆发。该战役属于马克姆河谷和拉穆河谷—芬尼斯特雷山脉战役的一部分。澳大利亚第7师于1943年9月中旬攻占莱城后，从杜姆普向北海岸马当附近的博加吉姆推进，沿途在新几内亚领地的芬尼斯特雷山脉山麓与日军发生一系列战斗。

en.s: Black Friday is the nickname given by the Black Watch (Royal Highland Regiment) of Canada to the date 13 October 1944. On that day, during World War II's Battle of the Scheldt in the Netherlands, the regiment's only overseas battalion attacked German positions on a raised railway embankment near the village of Hoogerheide after advancing across 1,200 yards of open beet fields.

en.s: A constitutional referendum was held in France on 13 October 1946. Voters were asked whether they approved of a new constitution proposed by the Constituent Assembly elected in June. Unlike the May referendum, which saw a previous constitutional proposal rejected, the new Constitution of 27 October 1946 was accepted by 53% of voters, and brought the Fourth Republic into existence. Voter turnout was 68%.

en.s: Uruguayan Air Force Flight 571 was the chartered flight of a Fairchild FH-227D from Montevideo, Uruguay, to Santiago, Chile, that crashed in the Andes mountains in Argentina on 13 October 1972. The accident and subsequent survival became known as both the Andes flight disaster (Tragedia de los Andes, literally Tragedy of the Andes) and the Miracle of the Andes (Milagro de los Andes).

en.s: Aeroflot Flight 217 was a non-scheduled international passenger flight from Orly Airport in Paris to Sheremetyevo International Airport in Moscow, with a stopover at Shosseynaya Airport (now Pulkovo Airport) in Leningrad (now Saint Petersburg). On 13 October 1972, the Ilyushin Il-62 airliner operating the flight crashed on approach to Sheremetyevo, with the loss of all 164 passengers and crew of 10.

zh.t: 俄罗斯航空217号班机空难
zh.s: 俄罗斯航空217号班机是一趟非定期国际客运航班，从巴黎奥利机场飞往莫斯科谢列梅捷沃机场，中途停靠列宁格勒的绍谢伊纳亚机场（现圣彼得堡普尔科沃机场）。1972年10月13日，执飞该航班的伊尔-62客机在降落谢列梅捷沃机场时坠毁，机上164名乘客和10名机组人员全部遇难。

en.t: 1974 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship final
en.s: The 1974 All-Ireland Senior Ladies' Football Championship Final was the first All-Ireland final. It featured Tipperary and Offaly. Tipperary won the final by 2–3 to 2–2. Towards the end of the first half, Tipperary were leading by 1–2 to 0–0. However within minutes of the restart Offaly took the lead with a goal. Tipperary came back and, with about eight minutes to go, went ahead with a point from a free.

en.s: On 13 October 1976, a Boeing 707, a chartered cargo aircraft operated for Lloyd Aéreo Boliviano (LAB) crashed shortly after takeoff at El Trompillo Airport, Santa Cruz de la Sierra, Bolivia, into a residential neighbourhood. All three crew on board were killed, along with 88 other fatalities on the ground, bringing the total up to 91. It is the deadliest air disaster to happen on Bolivian soil.

en.s: Lufthansa Flight 181, a Boeing 737-200 jet airliner (reg. en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 13 October 1985. The Christian People's Party emerged as the largest party, with 49 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 25 of the 106 seats in the Senate. Elections to the nine provincial councils were also held. The incumbent government was a coalition of Christian democrats (CVP/PSC) and liberals (PVV/PRL) led by Prime Minister Wilfried Martens. Following the elections, the same parties formed a new Martens Government. Guy Verhofstadt, PVV leader since 1982, was elected for the first time as representative.

zh.s: 比利时于1985年10月13日举行大选。基督教人民党成为最大党，在众议院212席中获得49席，在参议院106席中获得25席。九个省议会也同时举行选举。时任政府由基督教民主党（CVP/PSC）和自由党（PVV/PRL）组成联合政府，总理由威尔弗里德·马尔滕斯担任。选举后，原有政党再次联合，组成新一届马尔滕斯政府。PVV党魁居伊·费尔霍夫施塔特自1982年起担任党魁，此次首次当选众议员。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Poland on 13 October 1985. According to the Constitution of 1952 the elections should have been held every 4 years, that is in the spring of 1984, but since the internal political situation was still considered "unstable" even after the repealing in 1983 of the Martial Law, the Sejm voted to extend its own term at first indefinitely (on February 13, 1984) and then until August 31, 1985 (on December 3, 1984), fixing the elections to be held not beyond the end of 1985.

zh.s: 波兰于1985年10月13日举行议会选举。根据1952年宪法，选举本应每四年举行一次，也就是在1984年春季举行。但1983年解除戒严后，国内政治局势仍被认为“不稳定”。众议院于1984年2月13日先将本届任期无限期延长，随后又于同年12月3日决定将任期延长至1985年8月31日，并规定选举不得晚于1985年底举行。

en.s: The War of Liberation (Arabic: حرب التحرير) was a sub-conflict within the final phase of the Lebanese Civil War between 1989 and 1990, in which the Lebanese Army loyal to General and Prime Minister Michel Aoun, appointed by previous President Amine Gemayel and headquartered in eastern Beirut, fought against the western Beirut-based Syrian Armed Forces and the Lebanese Army loyal to President Elias Hrawi and Prime Minister Salim el-Hoss, appointed by the Taif Agreement. Aoun launched several offensives against the Lebanese Forces in an attempt to establish his authority over East Beirut. The conflict culminated on 13 October 1990, when the Syrian Army stormed Baabda Palace and other strongholds of Aoun, killing hundreds of Lebanese soldiers and civilians and ousting Aoun, marking the end of the Lebanese Civil War.

zh.s: 解放战争（阿拉伯语：حرب التحرير）是1989至1990年黎巴嫩内战最后阶段的一场内部冲突。忠于将军兼总理米歇尔·奥恩的黎巴嫩军队与驻扎在贝鲁特东部的部队交战；奥恩由前总统阿明·杰马耶勒任命。对手包括驻在贝鲁特西部的叙利亚武装部队，以及效忠总统埃利亚斯·赫拉维和总理萨利姆·胡斯的黎巴嫩军队，两人由《塔伊夫协议》任命。奥恩发动多次攻势，试图确立其对东贝鲁特的控制。冲突于1990年10月13日达到高潮，叙利亚军队攻入巴卜达宫和奥恩的其他据点，杀死数百名黎巴嫩军人和平民，并将奥恩赶下台。这标志着黎巴嫩内战结束。

en.s: W.A.K.O. World Championships 1991 were the eight world kickboxing championships hosted by the W.A.K.O. organization. It was the third world championships to be held in London, involving amateur men and women from twenty-eight countries across the world. There were three styles on offer; Semi-Contact, Light-Contact and Musical Forms, and for the first time since Milan 1981, there would be no Full-Contact kickboxing competition at a W.A.K.O. world championships. Each country was allowed one competitor per weight division per category, although participants were allowed to participate in more than one category.

en.s: The 2024 Macanese Chief Executive election was held on 13 October 2024 for the 6th term of the Chief Executive of Macau (CE), the highest office of the Macau Special Administrative Region. Incumbent Ho Iat Seng, who was elected in 2019, declined to seek a second term for health reasons and finished his term on 20 December 2024.

en.s: The 2024 Women's TEC Cup was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor hard courts. It was the second edition of the tournament, which was part of the 2024 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour. It took place in Cornellà de Llobregat, Barcelona, Spain, between 7 and 13 October 2024. This year the tournament's prize money was raised to $100,000 and it was moved from August to October.

zh.s: 2024年女子TEC杯是一项在室外硬地球场举行的职业网球赛事，也是该赛事第二届，属于2024年ITF女子世界网球巡回赛。赛事于2024年10月7日至13日在西班牙巴塞罗那省科尔内利亚-德略布雷加特举行。今年赛事奖金提高至10万美元，比赛时间也从8月改到10月。

en.s: The 57th Sitges International Fantastic Film Festival of Catalonia took place from 3 to 13 October 2024, in Sitges, Catalonia, Spain. Steven Soderbergh's psychological thriller film Presence opened the festival, while Alexandre Aja's survival horror film Never Let Go served as the festival's closing film. Austrian historical horror film The Devil's Bath, directed by Veronika Franz and Severin Fiala, won the Best Film award.

en.s: The 2024 PASOK – Movement for Change leadership election took place on the 6th of October 2024, with a second round on the 13th of the same month, in order to elect the president of PASOK – Movement for Change. It was triggered on June 30, following internal pressure on the incumbent President Nikos Androulakis, regarding the coalition's mediocre performance at the 2024 EU elections.

en.s: The 2025 Tuscan regional election took place in Tuscany, Italy, from 12 to 13 October 2025. In line with polls prediction and the region's left-leaning status, the incumbent president Eugenio Giani of the centre-left coalition was re-elected to a second term with 54% of the vote, compared to the 41% of centre-right coalition candidate Alessandro Tomasi.

en.s: The 63rd New York Film Festival took place from September 26 to October 13, 2025, in New York City, presented by Film at Lincoln Center. Luca Guadagnino's thriller film After the Hunt was the opening film. Jim Jarmusch's anthology drama film Father Mother Sister Brother was the festival's centerpiece. Bradley Cooper's comedy Is This Thing On? was the closing film.
